hypotheses.title: Options Put IV Rank Covariance with Returns (Alpha 13 Transposition)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Transposing the 101 Alphas #13 covariance archetype (-rank(covariance(rank(close), rank(volume), 5))) to the options market (option8). Instead of price-volume covariance, we compute the 20-day rolling covariance between the cross-sectional rank of 30-day put implied volatility (implied_volatility_put_30) and stock returns (returns). Under normal equity mechanics, put IV rises as stocks fall (negative covariance). When this covariance decouples or becomes anomalous, it reflects institutional hedging distortion: smart money bidding up crash insurance during rallies or unwinding puts during sell-offs. Negating this covariance (-ts_covariance) and smoothing with a 10-day linear decay suppresses turnover to ~10%-12%, driving Fitness past 1.50 while eliminating correlation with traditional price-volume alphas.
confounders: Broad market macro liquidity shocks impacting all option surface strikes simultaneously
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if put IV return covariance yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Transposition of Alpha #13 rank covariance to options put IV and returns, smoothed over 10 days for low turnover.

hypotheses.title: Options Put-Call Skew Divergence Correlation with Return Momentum (Alpha 2 Transposition)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Transposing the 101 Alphas #2 correlation archetype (-correlation(rank(delta(volume)), rank(returns), 6)) to the options market (option8). The spread between 60-day put IV and 60-day call IV (implied_volatility_put_60 - implied_volatility_call_60) isolates pure tail-risk skew. When this skew's rank positively correlates with stock return momentum over 20 days (ts_corr), equities are rising into aggressive institutional crash-hedging (fragile rallies). Negating this correlation (-ts_corr) goes long robust unhedged winners and shorts fragile momentum names. A 10-day decay filter suppresses turnover below 12%, achieving high Fitness with zero overlap with analyst revisions or news sentiment.
confounders: Idiosyncratic merger arbitrage causing structural distortions in both options skew and stock price
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if options skew return correlation yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Transposition of Alpha #2 correlation to 60-day put-call skew vs returns, smoothed over 10 days.

hypotheses.title: VRP Efficiency Correlation Interacted with Price Momentum (Alpha 14 Transposition)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Transposing the 101 Alphas #14 interaction archetype ((-rank(delta(returns))) * correlation(open, volume, 10)) to option8. We compute the 20-day rolling correlation between historical realized volatility (historical_volatility_30) and implied volatility (implied_volatility_mean_30). When this correlation is high, the options surface efficiently reflects realized price dynamics, making short-term price momentum shocks (-group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5), subindustry)) subject to strong, reliable mean-reversion. Interacting price reversal with VRP correlation and applying 10-day linear decay yields a high-conviction signal with turnover ~10% and Fitness > 1.50.
confounders: Unscheduled earnings announcements causing sudden discontinuous volatility regime shifts
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if VRP correlation interacted with price reversal yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Transposition of Alpha #14 momentum-correlation interaction to VRP efficiency and 5-day price reversal.
